# Roadmap: Database Administrator

## Role overview

Installs, tunes, backs up and secures databases.

## Prerequisites

- None. Start with Stage 1.
- Usually 1+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [SQL](../topics/database-sql.md)
- [ ] [Linux & Shell](../topics/linux.md)

## Also needed

Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, pgAdmin, SSMS, Oracle Enterprise Manager

## Where it leads

Grow: Data Engineer, Data Architect · Lead: — · Pivot: Cloud Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), Platform Engineer
